refs.carved: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: MULTIVIEW construction reference for a six-study 3D hybrid experiment. One handheld ASYMMETRIC containment capsule, a protective open rigid frame around a bulbous organic core, and a real diagonal cloth binding. Not a bottle, shield, staff, flat amulet or glowing orb. Compact squat full-volume object, overall height:width:depth approximately 3.6:2.5:1.3. No writing, symbols, labels, scenery, shadows on ground or tiny ornament. Genuinely transparent background. Four views of EXACTLY THE SAME OBJECT arranged 2 by 2: TOP LEFT front, TOP RIGHT right side, BOTTOM LEFT back, BOTTOM RIGHT true top-down. Orthographic views, front/right/back equal height and scale. Rigid casing is OPEN at upper centre, real air above organic core. Core sits low and slightly to right. Left protective cheek rises higher and hooks inward above the opening; right cheek shorter and flared, front plates wrap toward back, thick real edges. Rear has a curved support spine and binding attachments. One broad cloth strap crosses diagonally from upper left to lower right and wraps around the back, with a short hanging tail below left. Preserve full silhouettes, generous space between views. Strong 96px readability, big primary forms, substantial support, no microdetail. Neutral even illumination, no dramatic specular or baked shadows. Direction A: FIELD-CARVED keepsake made of irregular weathered bone/stone ceramic and dark walnut. Broad rounded worn edges, large carved surface breaks, imperfect asymmetry, honey ochre housing, muted coral-red organic seed core, dark indigo cloth band. Upper left cheek like a thick bent tooth, right cheek like a squat jaw fragment. A few broad grain planes, deliberately quiet wear. Warm, tactile, handmade. No gold filigree, no runes or ivory flower halo.

Direction B: INDUSTRIAL SALVAGE casing, built of dark blue-gray stamped metal plates with angular cut corners, chunky offset flanges and only four large visible fasteners. Core is muted teal-green organic sac with broad soft lobes; cloth band burnt orange. Left cheek a thick crooked sheet-metal hook, right cheek a stepped wide plate; back spine is welded blackened steel. Broad flat planes contrast against soft living core. Weathering only at a few purposeful edges, no noisy all-over rust. Practical, battered, asymmetrical; no ceremonial gold trim, no neon light.

surfaces.atlas: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: FLAT OPAQUE RGB MATERIAL ATLAS for 3D study models, not a picture of objects. Image1/2 are two distinct capsule directions; image3 is exact allocation guide. Produce a landscape1536x1024 atlas with two columns and four rows, eight flat edge-to-edge material panels separated by dark gray gutters. NO labels/text, objects, lighting, shadows, facets, outlines, drawn straps or bevels. Left column FIELD-CARVED, right INDUSTRIAL SALVAGE. In each row rectangle x24..744 on left or x792..1512 on right. Row1 y24..240: left warm honey bone ceramic, a few broad low-contrast brown worn patches; right medium light blue-gray steel, a few broad dull worn patches, no black material. Row2 y280..496: left muted terracotta/coral organic seed skin with a few quiet broad seams; right muted sage-teal sac skin with soft broad mottling. Row3 y536..752: left rich medium indigo cloth, right burnt orange fabric. Very soft directional textile colour, no woven microgrid or painted fold/lacing. Row4 y792..1000: left medium warm walnut with four broad faint grain lines, right medium graphite metal with faint broad brush marks. Keep ALL panels fairly bright and calm, largely flat local colour; actual model supplies lighting, geometry, curves and edges. Extremely restrained surface contrast. No engraved marks, scattered speckles, fake relief, perspective, shiny gem photos or fake AO.
surfaces.panels: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: flat component SILHOUETTE stencil sheet for surface-conforming 3D panels. Based on image1 field-carved capsule and image2 salvage capsule, make four separate flat FRONT outlines of their left and right protective cheek plates. GENUINELY TRANSPARENT background and wide transparent separation. Square2x2 sheet: TOP LEFT field-carved left cheek, TOP RIGHT field-carved right cheek; BOTTOM LEFT salvage left cheek, BOTTOM RIGHT salvage right cheek. Full each component, upright, no labels. Left cheek approxwidth:height1:3, long crescent-like strip from lower round jaw foot to upper thick hook bending toRIGHT. Open large inner edge facingRIGHT, no core/wood/cloth. Right cheek width:height1:2.4, shorter, a long jaw strip curving inward toLEFT at lower end, short shoulder atupperend; no core/cloth. Upper pair organic round imperfect ceramic silhouettes, flat ochre fill. Lower pair angular blue-gray steel silhouettes, broad geometric plane breaks, 2big flange tabs per strip, thick hook; flat fill. These are actual isolated PARTS, never a whole capsule/armor. No shadow, perspective, thickness render, bolts, holes in plates, white rectangle backing, highlights or texture. Silhouette shape information only, solid interioralpha. Keep hook mouths wide so inner holes/gaps survive a coarse mesh.
